Original p.1 participation and inactives, p.3 punting, pp.9–15 injury plays and notices, p.18 offensive/defensive snaps. Placement and literal return wording reviewed separately.
Week 7 Browns position-specific depth; Austin Barber at RG, Dawand Jones swing reserve, Adin Huntington behind Graham at RDT and Emmanuel McNeil-Warren behind Delpit.

Cleveland team injury report for Week 7.

Cleveland dated transactions: Bell, Chatman and Ulofoshio reverted to reserve after injury waivers; Nathaniel Watson practice squad/injured; Gabriel designated return October 6 then activated October 26, after kickoff.
Official final report names Kalia Davis, Gabriel, Hall and Teven Jenkins as out; the four otherwise unarchived non-QB final inactives are not listed with an injury.
Cleveland activated Sampson, placed Teven Jenkins on IR, elevated Kamara and cleared Delpit from pregame concussion protocol before kickoff.
Tennessee promoted Horne, elevated Mullings and Osborn and confirmed Mausi remained on IR without activation.
Cleveland reported concussion evaluation for Howard and hamstring injury for Myles Harden.
Subsequent club confirmation that Howard was in concussion protocol following the Titans game; cleared ahead of Pittsburgh.
Cleveland identified Sam Kamara as professional interior depth used to absorb Graham/Hall injuries in Week 5.

Team depth chart labelled October 26, 2026; listed Nazir Stackhouse and Timmy Horne directly behind Franklin-Myers; Dike directly behind Ridley; Chestnut and Carter behind Pollard and reserve Spears/Singleton.
Club confirms Townsend injury in first half; Slye took exactly one emergency punt for 42 yards with no return, and converted every kicking attempt.
Team confirms it released Jordan Elliott on October 20, 2026 before October 25 kickoff.

specialistCases.rationale: Official gamebook and team notes show only one punt opportunity in absence; Slye handled it for 42 yards net, no return, inside the 20. No unfilled attempt or reported change to scoring/holding; Townsend was back as holder at Q4 8:44 and all Tennessee kicks were good. A one-opportunity professional fill without documented material disruption supports this limited assumption; possible counterfactual field-position effect remains unquantified.
